final: SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON CAST(s.arcref AS BLOB) = CAST(p.arcregistry AS BLOB)) AS count_divided_by_total, COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT fundflux) FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON CAST(s.arcref AS BLOB) = CAST(p.arcregistry AS BLOB)) AS count_minus_average FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON CAST(s.arcref AS BLOB) = CAST(p.arcregistry AS BLOB) GROUP BY fundflux HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT fundflux) FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON CAST(s.arcref AS BLOB) = CAST(p.arcregistry AS BLOB))
